REPEAT JOB — SAVED CALIBRATION
Repeat Job may automatically HOME XYZ as part of its proven recovery sequence. This HOME does not mean Steps 3–7 must be taught again while the physical setup remains unchanged.
For a changed/new setup: return to STEP 2 HOME XYZ → STEP 3 Surface Z → STEP 4 Bed/Paper Center before continuing.

  






  
LDM QUICK GUIDE
CALIBRATE ONCE · SAVE THE JOB · REPEAT WITH THE SAME PHYSICAL SETUP
The saved plotting reference belongs to the paper, tool and machine setup used when that job was prepared.

✓ SAFE TO REUSE THE SAVED SETUP
Same paper/material thickness · same build plate and placement · same pen/blade · same tool extension · nothing physically shifted.

    
↻ RECALIBRATE FIRST
Paper/material changed · pen/blade replaced or moved · tool extension changed · plate/setup moved · Surface Z is uncertain.

  

  
SURFACE Z IS PHYSICAL.A saved Z value is only valid for the setup that created it. HOME establishes machine coordinates; it does not rediscover where the pen or blade touches a changed material.

  
REPEAT FROM THE A1 DISPLAY
Goal: a saved LDM project can later prepare itself and run without LDM. The standalone project startup must perform HOME/reference preparation before using its saved calibrated Surface Z.
G28 / HOME → INITIALIZE → SAVED REFERENCE → SAVED SURFACE Z → PLOT

Tool Mode















Pen calibration




 
 
 
 
 
 









Calibration can be changed later. V1 uses relative Z lift.







Vinyl / Kiss Cut













Depth offset is software-limited to 0–0.30 mm. With a saved Surface Z Mesh, the blade follows the calibrated physical surface continuously: local Surface Z − Cut Depth while cutting, local Surface Z + Blade Lift while travelling. Use a sacrificial cutting mat and calibrate from zero contact.

Z MESH: NOT SAVED

 
Teach workflow: HOME XYZ → manually establish paper center/contact → SET BED/PLATE CENTER → select mesh. PREV/NEXT automatically lifts Z and moves XY to the selected mesh point. At the destination, manually establish SURFACE Z until the pen just touches → CAPTURE CURRENT Z. Automatic teach movement never lowers the pen.



 
LASER: saved Surface Z Mesh is available for reference but is NOT APPLIED to laser motion.

Draw freely with mouse, stylus, or finger. Each press-and-drag gesture becomes one centerline stroke. Lift and draw again for disconnected parts. No grid and no snapping. Font editing sends no machine motion.

 







Safety

V1.3 never generates heater/extruder commands. Laser mode is simulation-only and generates no laser-on/PWM commands. HOME and physically verify clearance before a real pen test. STOP lifts the pen and disables XYZ motors; it cannot erase already queued printer motion.
